column1: # Third-party binaries that CI and local tooling download, pinned by content.
# Every download goes through scripts/ci/fetch-verified.sh, which refuses to
# hand a file to the caller unless its SHA-256 matches the digest below. A
# pinned version alone is not integrity protection: an upstream release tag can
# be deleted and re-cut with different bytes, and the runners that fetch these
# binaries hold a GITHUB_TOKEN and execute PR code.
# Columns, whitespace-separated:
#   name    lookup key passed to fetch-verified.sh
#   arch    architecture this row's digest belongs to (amd64, arm64, or any)
#   sha256  expected digest of the downloaded file
#   url     download location
# Bumping a version means replacing the url AND the sha256 in the same edit.
# kind, yq and helm-docs each publish a checksum file next to their release
# assets -- take the digest from there rather than from a local download:
#   kind       <url>.sha256sum
#   yq         .../checksums (SHA-256 is the column named in checksums_hashes_order)
#   helm-docs  .../checksums.txt
# tlaplus publishes no checksums, so tla2tools.jar is pinned from the artifact
# itself; a mismatch there means the release tag was re-cut and needs a look
# before the digest is updated.
